description: This file defines the 'Tax' class within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Total'. It extends the base engine model and provides a method 'getTotal' that calculates and adds tax details to the totals array while updating the total amount. The class is part of the total extension of the Opencart catalog module, specifically handling tax calculations for the checkout process.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Handles tax calculation and integration within the total calculation process in the Opencart catalog extension namespace.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates total tax based on the provided taxes array and updates the totals array and total amount accordingly.
